pages.text: $(bold)Tier 4 reached.$() The top of the ladder.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Dimensions:$() the Aether (Deep Aether's biomes included), and beyond it The End.$(li)$(bold)Tech:$() advanced Mekanism, RFTools Dimensions.$(li)$(bold)Magic:$() Mahou Tsukai.$(li)$(bold)Gear:$() Netherite, Gaia, Antimatter, Atomic Alloy.$(br2)There is no token gate beyond here.

pages.title: The Finale
pages.text: Eyes of Ender lead you to The End - see $(l:icraft:progression/dimensions)Dimensional Progression$(/l). Defeat the $(t4)Ender Dragon$() to win. The Ad Astra planets are open to you now too: a rocket, no dragon kill.$(br2)Your surplus tokens now have a new use: the $(l:icraft:progression/token_exchange)Token Exchange$(/l) turns them into experience.
